text:
maria s: handing off — I'm ending my shift now (05:00 UTC). Quick incident summary before I go:

incident-bot: [PAGE] Sev2 token-serving-errors — 2025-06-12 04:48 UTC. INC-4091 created: https://redwood.incidents/INC-4091

maria s: We saw ~6.2% 5xxs for the token-service for ~12m. Root cause: aggressive autoscaler smoothing change + high long-seq traffic -> KV cache evictions -> increased cold starts and fallback routing. Mitigation already applied: rolled back autoscaler config (policy=v1.2 -> v1.1), manually bumped pool by +2 nodes, raised cache TTL for hot prefixes. Latency returned to baseline ~06:10 UTC.

alex k: taking primary for the handoff. Any immediate customer-impact follow-ups I should run?

maria s: main affected customers: acme-demo, edu-labs (both in us-west). Support ticket numbers appended in incident ticket. No data loss. Recommend outreach to acme-demo PM with summary + ETA for fix.

priya n: I'll cover secondary. Are there any coverage gaps in the 11:00-12:00 UTC window tomorrow? I have a calendar conflict 11:30-12:15.

maria s: gap noted. Alex — can you cover 11:30-12:15 or swap with Sam?

alex k: I can cover 11:30-12:00 but need to hand off to Priya for the remaining 15m. Sam, can you pick up 12:00-12:15?

sam t: I can take 12:00-12:15. Added to rotation calendar.

ops-runbooks-bot: Runbook pointer: https://docs.redwood/ops/runbooks/token-serving

maria s: Runbook step we missed: check the kvcache eviction metrics. Query to run if you need to triage quickly:
```
# example
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=token-service | grep "kvcache.eviction" | tail -n 200
# or via prometheus
rate(kvcache_evictions_total{job="token-service"}[5m]) > 0
```

alex k: good. I'm going to open follow-up tickets for (1) autoscaler smoothing revert permanent fix, (2) add alert on eviction rate, (3) customer comms. I'll link them here.

sam t: created ticket RWD-2387 - Autoscaler smoothing: https://jira.redwood/browse/RWD-2387 :white_check_mark:

priya n: filed RWD-2388 - Eviction alert + grafana dashboard: https://jira.redwood/browse/RWD-2388

dave l: scheduled incident retro for Friday 2025-06-13 16:00 UTC (30m). Calendar invite sent.

maria s: action items before next handoff:
- Alex: own the autoscaler fix ticket (RWD-2387) and propose rollout plan (due EOD tomorrow)
- Priya: add eviction alert and dashboard (RWD-2388), include expected thresholds
- Sam: coordinate customer comms with Support for acme-demo and edu-labs (add summary to INC-4091)
- Dave: run retrospective and capture owner/resolution timeline in the incident doc

alex k: noted. I'll ping here when RWD-2387 has a PR or plan.

sam t: added short summary to INC-4091 and pinged support channel for acme-demo outreach.

incident-bot: Incident INC-4091 updated: severity -> resolved degraded routing. Duration: 22m. Postmortem task created.

maria s: handing off — thanks everyone. If anything urgent, page me direct (maria). :thumbsup:

alex k: thanks — taking over. :eyes:

priya n: thanks! will check dashboards in 15m and follow up on eviction alert.
